MemeDef.label: puppet path
MemeDef.description: Whoever pulls the strings does not need to be strong, only patient. Lend a piece of your soul to wood and bronze and let it stand in your place: a calm will can guide a hundred bodies without risking a single life.

rulesStrings.li: creation(tag=meme_CVG_Meme_PuppetPath)->[deity0_name] carved a figure out of the first tree and lent it a thread of [deity0_possessive] own soul.
episode(uses=1,tag=meme_CVG_Meme_PuppetPath)->[deity0_name] showed the first [memberName] that a body is only a puppet the soul forgot it was holding.
intro(tag=meme_CVG_Meme_PuppetPath)->The early [memberNamePlural] of the [place_summary] [place_name] toured the villages with a shadow theatre, and nobody looked behind the screen.
conflict(tag=meme_CVG_Meme_PuppetPath)->A powerful [foeLeader] called the [memberNamePlural] cowards who would not fight with their own hands.
founderJoin(tag=meme_CVG_Meme_PuppetPath)->[founderName] cut a puppet's strings to save [memberName] from a fire, and the puppet walked out of the flames anyway.
victory(tag=meme_CVG_Meme_PuppetPath)->[founderName] sent a hundred puppets against the [foeLeader], and not one believer was hurt when the [foeSoldiers] fled.
setup(tag=meme_CVG_Meme_PuppetPath)->The Iron Calamity burned the believers' valley, so they took apart the machines that did it and learned how they walked.
story(uses=1,tag=meme_CVG_Meme_PuppetPath)->The believers spread out and grew in number, each one followed by puppets of their own making.
lessonIntro(tag=meme_CVG_Meme_PuppetPath)->Disciple, the old masters used to say:
lesson(tag=meme_CVG_Meme_PuppetPath)->whoever pulls the strings does not need to be strong, only patient.
lessonReinforcement(tag=meme_CVG_Meme_PuppetPath)->You will understand it the day you forget which hand moves which thread.
archistFact(tag=meme_CVG_Meme_PuppetPath)->The archotechs are puppeteers too; we simply have not found their threads yet.
archistProphecy(tag=meme_CVG_Meme_PuppetPath)->[inTheEnd], every machine will need a master, and the Valley will be ready.
animistFact(tag=meme_CVG_Meme_PuppetPath)->Every tree keeps a dance in its grain; the carver only lets it out.

IdeoPresetDef.label: invisible thread sect
IdeoPresetDef.description: Puppeteers of the Invisible Thread: patience over strength, a hundred bodies guided by one calm will. Cultivation is venerated, alchemy accepted, duels forbidden and secluded retreats revered. Your colony stays independent; the Valley is a teacher, not a master.

PreceptDef.label: puppet master
PreceptDef.description: The master who teaches the threads and binds each disciple's soul to the sect's puppets. Only someone whose own soul already frays into threads may hold the office: the Valley says you cannot teach a hand to let go if it has never held anything.

RitualPatternDef.ritualExplanation: The puppet master draws one disciple's soul into finer threads by a single grade: silk thread, steel thread, jade thread, heart of a thousand threads. A failed binding costs only the materials.

PreceptDef.label: binding of spirit threads
PreceptDef.description: The disciple sits blindfolded in a circle of puppets while the puppet master winds spirit thread around their fingers, one turn for each of the sect's masters. The others pull the puppets' strings in time; the binding holds when the disciple can tell, without looking, which puppet moved.
